sentences.en: The power company is responsible for providing electricity to our city.
sentences.zh: 电力公司负责为我们城市提供电能。

sentences.en: We contacted the local power company about an outage last night.
sentences.zh: 我们联系了当地电力公司关于昨晚的停电问题。

sentences.en: The new regulations will affect how power companies operate in the future.
sentences.zh: 新规定将影响未来电力公司的运营方式。
